items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee describes Belizario Lopez as a prominent figure in Cuban musical culture who 'played with everyone' and was 'in charge in Cuban culture', but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself and Lopez.

ctx.x: Belizario Lopez. He played with everyone, even with the Tipica orchestra because they had two clarinets and trumpets and bombardino and figles and the symphonic timbales, and he was all over the place. He is, as a matter of fact is about six or seven months, the one that is in charge in Cuban culture, musical culture in Cuba, he was asking questions ah - - Mario about the Cuban music because Mario is older than him about twenty years.
How many instruments does Mario play?
